verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is CodeRabbit's own option to receive the Triage queue as a scheduled digest in Slack. That is a recurring, product-owned schedule, but it covers just one fixed digest type, not user-defined jobs or workflows. Auto-review and @coderabbitai commands are event-triggered or one-off actions, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for reviews, scans, or recipes; documented schedule configuration such as cron, frequency, or timezone; scheduling for workflows beyond the Triage digest; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Get your Triage queue as a scheduled digest
